channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Riyadh airport attack: 1 killed, 11 injured after Houthis launch strike; Iran-backed group issues warning | Top updates
item.description: At least one person was killed, and 11 others were injured after the Houthis launched another attack targeting Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid International Airport on Sunday. The latest attack disrupted flights, prompted travel warnings, and drew international condemnation.

item.title: Congress march to SC to demand end to 'vote chori' today: Are metros, schools, and offices open today?
item.description: The Congress has termed Monday's protest “Chalo Delhi - March for Democracy,” with leaders scheduled to converge at the Connaught Place-Barakhamba Road junction at 1.30 pm.

item.title: CJP protest day 2: How Delhi unfolded amid fresh detentions, Supreme Court intervention and calls for CEC’s resignation
item.description: Around 200 people were detained as CJP protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar entered day two in Delhi. The Supreme Court cautioned against illegal detention, while party leaders vowed to continue protests nationwide.

item.title: How a power bank forced Chennai-bound IndiGo flight to divert to Hyderabad
item.description: IndiGo said smoke was detected from a passenger's personal electronic device, following which the crew brought the situation under control and the pilots diverted the flight to Hyderabad.

item.title: CJP Delhi protest: Filmmaker alleges harassment, claims ‘BJP-backed goons broke camera lens’, shares video as ‘proof’
item.description: Independent filmmaker Nihit, 23, alleged that a group of 10 to 15 people harassed him and broke his camera lens while he filmed a protest in Delhi’s Connaught Place on October 10 amid CJP's protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar.

item.title: Prakash Rajpurohit appointed Deputy Election Commissioner: Know about the IAS officer
item.description: Born on 28 February 1986, Prakash Rajpurohit is a Rajasthan-cadre IAS officer from the 2010 batch. He holds a Bachelor of Technology degree in Electrical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi.

item.title: CJI Surya Kant rejects meeting with Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge over SIR, police action on protestors
item.description: Chief Justice Surya Kant declined Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge’s request to meet, saying their concerns would be better addressed through judicial proceedings. The opposition leaders and INDIA bloc allies plan to march to the Supreme Court tomorrow.

item.title: Fuel deal gone too far? Trump wants 4.8 million tonnes of diesel from Russia: Can Moscow deliver what it promised?
item.description: Donald Trump says Russia will supply the US with 4.8 million tonnes of diesel amid falling Russian exports, sanctions concerns and questions over whether the deal will lower fuel prices. Here's what the numbers show

item.title: CJP leaders to visit Delhi police station tomorrow to seek date for Jantar Mantar ‘peaceful’ protest
item.description: CJP Co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka said the group would seek police permission for a Jantar Mantar protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. The group leaders said if date not given in 24 hours then ‘we will give another protest call ourselves’.

item.title: Bear Grylls’ 20-acre private island runs on wind, solar power and rainwater: How his family lives off-grid
item.description: Bear Grylls and his family spend part of the year on a 20-acre Welsh island without mains electricity or water. Their remote home relies on wind power, solar panels and harvested rainwater, offering privacy alongside the challenges of off-grid living

item.title: Riyadh airport attack kills Indian national in Saudi Arabia, injures 10 more: Embassy reacts, ‘Completely unacceptable’
item.description: An attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport killed 13 people, including an Indian national who later died of injuries, and wounded more than 300.&nbsp;

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says new attack at Riyadh airport day after strike killed 12, including one Indian: Details here
item.description: A fresh attack on Riyadh airport sparked a fire at Terminal 4 on Sunday, a day after a strike killed 12 people and injured more than 300. One Indian national has since died, while 10 others remain injured, the Indian Embassy said.

item.title: Russia Suffered 50,000 Casualties Last Month, NATO Official Says
item.description: Russia had more than 50,000 casualties in Ukraine last month, with as many as 28,000 personnel killed — vastly more than losses by Ukrainian forces, according to a senior NATO military official.

item.title: US weather alert: Tornado watch issued for 10 counties in North Carolina, South Carolina
item.description: Videos circulating on social media appeared to show a tornado moving through Allendale County.

item.title: Trump opens door to Russian oil. A Reagan-inspired bill could shut it: What is ‘Peace Through Strength Act'?
item.description: Trump’s Russian diesel deal faces a congressional challenge as Brian Fitzpatrick proposes the Ronald Reagan Peace Through Strength Act. Here is what the bill means.

item.title: Dhruv Rathee alleges ‘kidnapping’ after release amid CEC protest in Delhi: A look at his education, YouTube career
item.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee alleged that about 20 people in plain clothes took him from his home on Saturday and brought him to multiple police stations. He said he was denied access to his phone and lawyer for nearly 22–23 hours. A look at his education, YouTube career amid his India visit from Germany.

item.title: Cockroaches currently in Delhi should stay back: CJP's ‘important’ message says ‘next call on its way!’
item.description: The Cockroach Janta Party urged supporters in Delhi to stay back, saying its “Next call is on its way” after police detained thousands during Saturday’s protest.

item.title: Djibouti boat capsizes with 305 migrants on board, at least 139 dead and 84 missing in deadly shipwreck
item.description: At least 139 people, including children, have died and 84 remain missing after a boat carrying 305 migrants capsized off Djibouti. Rescue operations continue as the tragedy highlights the dangers of the migration route towards Yemen and Gulf nations.

item.title: Did Abhijeet Dipke refuse to call his father after grandmother's death? New video counters CJP leader's claim | Watch
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke and Delhi Police have offered conflicting accounts of whether officers let him call family after his grandmother died. Dipke said he was denied phone and lawyer access while police said he declined calls and travel help.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump announces ‘energy ceasefire’ between Russia and Ukraine, urges both sides not to break it
item.description: Trump on Saturday also urged Ukraine to get a new president, saying that Zelensky should be replaced by a leader that will settle the war.

item.title: IIT Kanpur alumnus unable to find job in US for two years, raises ₹8 lakh through GoFundMe
item.description: Gautam Dev highlighted the changing dynamics of the IT industry and the artificial intelligence boom as key challenges.

item.title: ₹2,459 crore Ponzi case: ED alleges investor funds routed through family accounts and firms; 35K duped — Details
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate has filed a prosecution complaint against five individuals and entities over an alleged ₹2,459 crore Ponzi scheme that reportedly defrauded more than 35,000 investors. Alleged mastermind Shivanand Siddappa Neelannavar, arrested on August 13, remains in judicial custody.

item.title: Dual Tropical Storms Hit Both US Coasts With Floods and Outages
item.description: More than 440,000 homes and businesses from Pennsylvania to Florida are without power and flood threats are rising at both ends of the country as the US deals with a rare double tropical threat from the remnants of storms Isaias off the Atlantic and Rachel moving into the Southwest from the Pacific.

item.title: 4 years after death, Sidhu Moosewala's hologram show debuts in Canada; song nears 900 million views on YouTube
item.description: The song has garnered nearly 900 million views and 12 million likes on his YouTube channel. The opening ceremony of Moosewala's hologram concert was attended by his parents.

item.title: Delhi Protests: SC issues contempt notice over alleged October 9 order breach, illegal detention of protesters
item.description: The Supreme Court issues contempt notices over alleged violations of its October 9 Delhi protests order, seeking responses and a compliance report by October 13.

item.title: 'First provide connections to poor in America': Nishikant Dubey slams Elon Musk, says Starlink poses security threats
item.description: BJP MP Nishikant Dubey urged Elon Musk to offer affordable internet to Americans before criticising India’s stance on Starlink. Dubey cited security concerns raised by Indian agencies and said national policy would not change under commercial or social-media pressure.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Silencing the truth’: Hotmail's Sabeer Bhatia reacts as YouTube blocks ‘How Modi and Adani Stole India’
item.description: YouTube blocks Sabeer Bhatia's ‘How Modi and Adani Stole India’ in India after a government complaint. TMC MP Mahua Moitra shares the video on X.

item.title: Watch | Chennai-bound IndiGo flight diverted to Hyderabad after fire breaks out due to malfunctioning power bank
item.description: Chennai-bound IndiGo flight diverted to Hyderabad after fire breaks out due to malfunctioning power bank

item.title: PM Modi inaugurates Chennai Metro Phase 2: Know Yellow Line stations, timings and other key details
item.description: The stations covered under the new Metro Yellow Line are Poonamallee Bypass, Poonamallee Bus Stand, Poonamallee Government Hospital, Karayanchavadi, Kumananchavadi, Kattupakkam, Iyappanthangal, Thelliyaragaram, Porur Bypass, Porur Junction and Vadapalani.

item.title: ‘Will hit the streets again’: Soon after release, Abhijeet Dipke says CJP protests against Gyanesh Kumar will continue
item.description: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke says protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar will continue. Dipke and two fellow activists were released after being held in preventive detention, subject to a one-year bond to reportedly maintain peace and good behaviour.

item.title: Bangla Sahib row: Complaint filed against AAP; Delhi Police clarifies shoe video as CJP urges Sikhs to join protests
item.description: DSGMC files a complaint against Arvind Kejriwal and AAP leaders over the Bangla Sahib protest row as Delhi Police denies allegations of entering the gurdwara's main sanctum with shoes. Convert to PDF

item.title: Following Russia plague scare, India put its national laboratory network on alert, stocks adequate life-saving antibioti
item.description: India has alerted its national diagnostic laboratory network and state-level reference laboratories following reports of a laboratory worker's death in Russia after suspected pathogen exposure.

item.title: Delhi Protests: Was Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas ‘attacked’ by Delhi Police? CPI(M) shares video
item.description: CPI(M) has alleged that Delhi Police assaulted Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas during protests demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, sharing a video purportedly showing him injured.

item.title: Nepal floods: 10 missing, 6 bridges washed away as Budhi Gandaki river overflows | What we know
item.description: Nearly 35 houses in the Painyu and Bagar areas of Chumnubri Rural Municipality’s Ward 3 were swept away.

item.title: Delhi CJP protest: What Jantar Mantar 2.0 ‘shutdown’ may cost the public? Inside ‘ ₹91-crore’ bill
item.description: To protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, the CJP organised a protest at Jantar Mantar on October 10, prompting the Centre and police to take pre-emptive steps to avoid a July 20-like situation. But how much do these restrictions on the metro, internet, railways, and markets cost, and who pays for them?
